scheme_name: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to MSMEs: Assistance for Power Connection Charges
other_conditions: The applicant must be registered as an MSME.
The enterprise must have obtained acknowledgment or registration from the Ministry of MSME or the Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
The enterprise must be located outside GIDC/approved industrial parks.
Charges must be paid to the distribution licensee during the scheme's operative period.
Applications must be submitted within one year from the date of payment to the distribution licensee.
Eligibility category noted in source: Micro
Eligibility category noted in source: Small
Eligibility category noted in source: Medium
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of 35% on power connection charges up to ₹5,00,000.
application_link: Registration Process: Step-1: Visit the Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. Step-2: Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". Step-3: Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. Step-4: After verification, you will be registered successfully. Post-Registration Process: Step-1: Visit the Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP) portal. Click on "Login". Step-2: Enter the email address and password you used during registration. Step-3: Click the "Login" button to access your account. Step-4: Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process. Helpdesk : Contact Here.
